Alex (Auditor): Quick question — in the sample bundle you provided I found one KMS policy_sha256 that doesn't match the policy.json we downloaded. Which exact canonicalization method do you use to compute the hash?

Priya (sec-eng): Hi Alex — we compute sha256 over the compacted JSON (minified, sorted keys) of the key policy. Example command we run: ```jq -S . key-policy.json | tr -d '\n' | sha256sum```

Alex (Auditor): Thanks. I used straight `sha256sum key-policy.json` which kept whitespace. That explains the diff. Can you include the exact command in the README so we can reproduce?

Sanjay (eng-security): Good call. We'll add a small snippet to README and include both the raw export and the canonicalized policy we hashed (policy_canonical.json + policy_sha256).

Jon (infra): Also to note — we include CloudTrail event IDs for rotations in kms/rotations.csv. If you need a replayable export, reference the event id and the timestamp in the CSV.

Alex (Auditor): Great. One more micro-ask: can the manifest include the key alias and the policy_sha256 in the top-level envelope for each KMS file row? That speeds validation.

Priya (sec-eng): Yes. We'll add columns: alias,key_id,policy_sha256,rotation_version to kms/rotations.csv and also mirror alias+policy_sha256 in manifest.json rows.

Sanjay (eng-security): We'll also attach the GPG command to verify signatures and the sha256 file in README: 
```
gpg --verify bundle.manifest.sig bundle.manifest
sha256sum -c bundle.sha256
```

Jon (infra): Kicking a small re-export job to include the canonicalized policy files and updated manifest. @oncall-bot start export job --note="policy-canonicalize"

oncall-bot: Export job queued: job_id=job-2940001111-42, started_at=2026-08-11T10:12:05Z, target=s3://redwood-audit-exports/reexports/job-42. Progress will be posted here. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Alex (Auditor): Thanks — please post presigned link when ready and I'll re-validate. Appreciate the quick follow-up. :thumbsup:

Priya (sec-eng): Will do. ETA ~4 hours for the re-export, upload, and presigned URL. We'll include the README snippet showing the jq+sha256 command and the policy_canonical.json files for each key.

Sanjay (eng-security): Noted — we'll also add a short note in control_map.csv linking the kms rows to control IDs (SOC2 CC6, A.8/A.10 mapping).

oncall-bot: job_id=job-2940001111-42 update: bundle uploaded to s3://redwood-audit-exports/reexports/job-42/reexported-bundle.tar.gz; presigned URL valid 7 days."
